- Topic: Tax explanations issued on 28 January 2026 by the Polish Ministry of Finance (Gov.pl) regarding rules for determining the permanent establishment location for tax purposes within Poland, for invoicing using the National System of e-Invoices (Krajowy System e-Faktur, KSeF).
- Publication date: 28 January 2026.
- Contents: The explanations (Objaśnienia podatkowe) clarify how to determine where a permanent establishment is located in Poland for issuing invoices through KSeF.
